title: Sr. Team Member - Process Excellence
location: Chennai Alcob, Chennai, Tamil Nadu , India
jobDescription:
Role Purpose

To drive data-driven process excellence initiatives across Sourcing & Supply Chain (S&SC) by leveraging SAP systems, advanced data analytics, and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance efficiency, transparency, and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Analytics & Insights

  • Analyze large datasets from SAP (MM, SD, PP modules) and other systems to identify process gaps and inefficiencies.

  • Develop dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks for supply chain performance.

  • Generate actionable insights on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance.
  • Support predictive and prescriptive analytics initiatives

2. SAP & PLM Utilization & Process Optimization

  • Leverage SAP & PLM data for process standardization and improvement initiatives.

  • Identify data inconsistencies and drive data governance practices.

  • Collaborate with IT/SAP teams for system enhancements and automation.
  • Ensure correct usage of SAP transactions and master data integrity.

3. Process Excellence Initiatives

  • Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement projects across S&SC processes.

  • Map and redesign processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-delivery, inventory management).

  • Identify automation opportunities (RPA, workflows, digital tools).

  • Monitor process KPIs and ensure sustained improvements.

4. Data Governance & Quality

  • Define and implement data standards, validation rules, and governance frameworks.

  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of master data (vendor, material, pricing).

  • Perform regular audits on data quality and compliance.

5. Business Partnering

  • Work closely with Procurement, Planning, Logistics, Finance, and IT teams.

  • Translate business requirements into data models, reports, and dashboards.

  • Enable data-driven decision-making across functions.

6. Reporting & Visualization

  • Build and maintain dashboards using tools like Power BI / Tableau / Excel.

  • Automate routine reports and reduce manual intervention.

  • Provide leadership with periodic insights and performance reports.

Technical Skills (Critical)

SAP Expertise (Must Have)

  • Hands-on experience in SAP modules & PLM:

    • MM (Materials Management)

    • SD (Sales & Distribution)

    • PP (Production Planning) – optional but preferred

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Master data structures (Material, Vendor, BOM, Pricing)

    • Transaction-level data extraction and reporting

Data Analysis Skills (Must Have)

  • Advanced Excel (Pivot, Power Query, Macros preferred)

  • Experience with Power BI / Tableau

  • Basic knowledge of SQL / data querying

  • Data modelling and KPI design

Process Excellence Skills (Preferred)

  • Lean / Six Sigma (Green Belt preferred)

  • Process mapping tools (Visio, BPM tools)

  • Root cause analysis, problem-solving

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Attention to detail and data accuracy

  • Ability to translate data into business insights

  • Cross-functional collaboration

  • Continuous improvement mindset

jobDescription:

Reporting To (Solid): Regional Sales Manager

Matrix Reporting To (Dotted):NA

Grade: CG23-24A

Business Unit: LCV

Department: LCV

Sub Department:

Location: Regions

Job Purpose

Direct Reports (Position Title)

Resources

To drive sales growth within the designated geographic area or territory and managing dealerships effectively to increase the market share of LCV products and dealer engagement/satisfaction.

·

·

·

·

·

Team Size

Direct:

Total Team Size (On rolls): 77

Financial Dimensions

Revenue/ Budget Managed: 10-12 Crs

Non-Financial Dimensions

No. of Vendors/ No. of Products Managed:

Main Accountabilities

Qualifications & Experience

· Bachelors of Engineering plus MBA

· Prior Automotive experience preferably in commercial is required.

· A person willing to travel

· Data Driven/Analytical

· Basics of Automotive & Financial Knowledge

· Sales background preferred

Key Challenges of the Role

· Influencing Stakeholders

· Changing Market Conditions

Key Decisions Taken Independently

· Dealership Motivation Schemes to specific dealers

· Network Expansion (Secondary Outlet) to specific dealers

· Dealer Manpower requirement to specific dealers

· Financial tie ups with specific dealers

Areas where supervisor’s guidance/approval is required

· Competitive scheme communication

· Network expansion (Primary)

· On all above decisions taken independ

Product Knowledge:

· Stay updated on the features, specifications, and benefits of different vehicle models.

· Train sales representatives and dealership staff on product knowledge and selling techniques.

· Ensure that sales staff are equipped with the necessary information to effectively communicate with customers.

Market Analysis

· Conduct market research to identify customer needs, preferences, and trends.

· Monitor competitor activities and market trends to identify opportunities and threats.

· Use sales data and analytics to assess market performance and identify areas for improvement.

· Provide feedback to senior management on market conditions and sales performance.

Dealer Management

· Build and maintain strong relationships with dealerships and other stakeholders.

· Provide support and assistance to dealerships to maximize sales opportunities.

· Address any issues or concerns raised by dealerships promptly and effectively.

· Collaborate with dealerships to develop and implement promotional campaigns and events.

Sales Management

· Oversee sales activities within a designated geographical area.

· Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve targets.

· Manage a team of sales representatives and dealership staff.

· Conduct regular sales meetings and provide guidance and support to the team.

· Set sales targets for individual team members and monitor performance.

Administration and Reporting:

· Prepare regular reports on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities.

· Monitor inventory levels and ensure that dealerships have an adequate supply of vehicles.

· Coordinate with other departments, such as marketing and finance, to ensure alignment of sales activities with overall business objectives.

Team Development:

· Recruit, train, and develop sales representatives and dealership staff.

· Provide ongoing coaching and support to help team members improve their sales skills and performance.

· Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to help team members reach their full potential.

title: Territory Service Manager
jobDescription:
Business & Processes:

· Manage and supervise service operations within the territory, ensuring compliance with quality standards and service level agreements.

· Cultivate and sustain robust relationships with key customers, addressing their service requirements to ensure customer retention.

· Implementation of AL process changes and improvements across dealerships.

· New product establishment in the market in terms of executing Driver trainings, Back to back trails and complaint resolution.

· Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as TAT, repeat jobs, AL-Helpline, revenue streams, job cards, and claims processing to assess service performance. Identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions as needed.

· Product Performance reports – Capture and share field failures and co-ordinate for Joint inspection in identification of root-cause and corrective action.

· Product campaigns – Drive the dealerships in completion of product campaigs for the vehicles involved.

· Warranty and process audits at dealerships to ensure process adherence.

People Excellence:

· Lead and mentor a team of service professionals, providing guidance, training, and support to achieve performance targets and objectives.

· Work on improving the skill capabilities at dealership level – productives and front office staffs.

· Implement and enforce safety protocols and compliance standards within the service team to ensure a secure working environment.

Market Intelligence:

· Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and customer feedback to proactively enhance service offerings and stay competitive.

· Share information on competitive products and initiatives.

title: Territory Sales Manager
jobDescription:
Role

·       Responsible for the achievement of the annual targets in vehicle sales.

·       Responsible for creating enhanced awareness of brand Ashok Leyland and building market share.

Responsibilities

·       Key Responsibility for achieving Market Share of the products in the respective area office 

·       Support for launch of new products in their territory

·       Drive the dealer sales team to promote the products

·       Train the dealer sales executives on the products, operating processes, procedures, etc.

·       Ensure adherence to PRISM Process at Channels / Dealer locations

·       Lead , Motivate and Manage Dealer Sales team

·       Enhance customer connect and customer satisfaction.

·       Monitor costs, implement cost saving measures and ensure profitability of the dealer point.
